mechanism_narrative: A higher current value of CPIAUCSL (consumer price index) is associated with lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes corporate profit margins and increases risk aversion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns for instances where CPIAUCSL is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of unemployment rate exceeding 4.8% and federal funds rate exceeding 4.49% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases economic uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns for instances where UNRATE > 4.8 and FEDFUNDS > 4.49 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 2200), the decline in residential construction activity signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns for instances where HOUST < 2200 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current value of UNRATE (unemployment rate) is associated with lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated unemployment indicates economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns for instances where UNRATE is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns for instances where INDPRO < 100 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of real personal consumption (RSAFS) exceeding 350,000 million dollars and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 200 (1982-1984=100) signals a strong economy with rising inflation, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate continued growth and earnings expansion.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns for instances where RSAFS > 350000 and CPIAUCSL > 200 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real employment (PAYEMS) falls below 135,000 thousand persons, it signals a weakening labor market that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns for instances where PAYEMS < 135000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
